Sightseeing

Lake Tahoe Destinations

Your captain knows every hidden cove, legendary waterfall, and historic landmark on the lake.

Emerald Bay

Arguably the most famous destination on Lake Tahoe — one of the most photographed places on earth. Towering cliffs soar above the bay on the southwest shore. A once-in-a-lifetime experience.

Fannette Island

The only island on Lake Tahoe — in the middle of Emerald Bay, only accessible by boat. Hike to breathtaking panoramic views from the ruins of the Vikingsholm Tea House. A must-see!

Eagle Falls

Breathtaking natural waterfalls running from the shores of Emerald Bay up to Eagle Lake — seeing the falls from a private boat might just top it all!

Bonsai Rock

Natural stone "steps" allow guests to swim from the boat and climb to the top. At the summit, a bonsai tree has grown through deep rock crevices. You MUST jump off into the crystal-clear waters — it's Tahoe tradition!

Sand Harbor

White-sand beaches, giant bleached boulders, and turquoise see-to-the-bottom waters. Your charter anchors inside an almost fully protected cove flanked by ancient boulders.

Cave Rock

One of the most majestic landmarks on Lake Tahoe — a portion of highway blasted through rock on the East Shore, towering above crashing whitecap waves.

Chambers Landing

The oldest lakefront boat-in bar on Lake Tahoe, built in 1875. Famous for the "Chambers Punch" — a secret epic blend of rums with a tropical kick. Ask your Captain to stop here!

DL Bliss State Park

Tahoe's go-to spot for rock and cliff jumping. Multiple heights available — all ages welcome! Rocks tower hundreds of feet into the sky and straight down into the blue depths.

Camp Richardson

A historic marina and recreation area for over 100 years! The Grove restaurant, full service boat dock with fuel, white sand beach, live music and more.

Ski Run Marina

The best waterfront dining in South Lake Tahoe: Riva Grill, Artemis Lakefront, Bear Moon, Empanash, a beach, marina and more!

El Dorado Beach

Lakeview Commons features free live music on their beach amphitheatre every Thursday of summer! Charter your boat to anchor out for live tunes at sunset.

Meek's Bay

One of the oldest settlements in Tahoe (1928) with some of the most beautiful shoreline on the entire lake, and Meek's Creek flowing down from Rubicon Lake.

The Beach Retreat

Casual tropical Tiki Bar on the beach or the upscale panoramic Boat House Restaurant on the Pier. A can't-miss boat-in spot!

Edgewood Resort

Home of the famous Celebrity Golf Tournament — sprawling grounds with multiple restaurants, pools, and gorgeous coastline. A private charter favorite!

Winter Season

Tahoe in Winter

The magic doesn't end when the snow falls. Enjoy winter boat charters, ski resort shuttles, snowshoe tours, and holiday decoration packages. Tahoe in winter is a wonderland.
